title: Micro-onramp SDK example packs: Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP server, CLI + ergonomic streaming/retry patterns
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Goal: ship four compact, production-oriented example packs (Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP server, and a CLI) that demonstrate recommended Redwood SDK usage patterns: ergonomic streaming, robust retries/backoff/idempotency, light-weight batching, environment config for hosted vs private deployments, and minimal local dev setup. Each pack should be runnable in <10 minutes, include a short README with integration checklist, a Dockerfile for local run, one CI job to smoke-test flows, and a small test harness that verifies deterministic sample output. The examples should be opinionated: show the recommended retry policy, streaming cancellation pattern, prefix/KV cache usage, and cost-aware batching snippets. Deliverables should be easy to copy into customer repos and serve as canonical snippets for docs and the Console quickstarts.
acceptance_criteria: Four example packs committed to the sdks/example-packs repo: nextjs-onramp, fastapi-onramp, go-http-onramp, cli-onramp
Each pack includes: README, Dockerfile, runnable demo script, one integration test, and explicit env var matrix (HOSTED vs DEDICATED vs PRIVATE)
Streaming example shows token-by-token client consumption, server-side graceful cancellation, and a snippet for cleanup on aborted streams
Retry example demonstrates exponential backoff + jitter, transparent idempotency token usage, and guidance for when to retry vs fail
Cookbook contains 6 short snippets: batching config, cache warm-up, kernel-aware length hints, structured output parsing, function/tool calling example, and token cost estimation
CI smoke test runs in <= 3 minutes and asserts deterministic outputs for the sample prompts or stable streaming behavior (mocked model)
tasks: Finalize example contracts and minimal API surface for code reuse across languages
Implement Next.js example: server proxy route, client streaming UI, reconnect/backoff sample
Implement FastAPI example: server streaming endpoint, request batching, example health endpoints
Implement Go HTTP server example: graceful shutdown, KV cache warm-up, low-latency handler with context cancellation
Implement CLI example: prompt templates, resume-on-failure, --batch-size and --region flags, human-friendly output formatter
Author cookbook snippets and short README best-practices (max 1 page each) for docs inclusion
Add integration tests: use mocked model server for deterministic CI assertions
Create PRs, address review feedback, and prepare release notes + docs crosslinks
